description: Decide when and how to assess minimal residual disease (MRD) in multiple myeloma — bone marrow MRD by next-generation flow (NGF) or sequencing (NGS), plus imaging MRD by PET-CT — and how to act on the result. Trigger when a clinician asks "how to assess MRD in myeloma", "MRD-negative complete response", "PET-CT for MRD", "is bone marrow MRD enough", "when to test for MRD", "next-generation flow for myeloma", or "myeloma sustained MRD negativity". Based on EHA-ESMO 2021.
